Yoshino Ohtori (Japanese: 鳳芳野 Ōtori Yoshino) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Ohtori was born on March 19, 1947, in , . She has been voice acting since 1976 and started work on the in , where she voiced . She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
